atoms.exact_source_text: A Keepsake may be endangered by the world
atoms.normalized_claim: A Keepsake may be endangered by the world.

atoms.exact_source_text: only the player may sever it from the Citizen.
atoms.normalized_claim: Only the player may sever a Keepsake from the Citizen.

atoms.exact_source_text: Keepsake eligibility is Citizen-specific and may arise from prior life, an acquisition event, inheritance, relationship, or an existing Hearth gift.
atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsake eligibility is Citizen-specific and may arise from prior life, an acquisition event, inheritance, relationship, or an existing Hearth gift.

atoms.exact_source_text: An arrival may already possess a functioning Keepsake from their Prior-Life Tale.
atoms.normalized_claim: An arrival may already possess a functioning Keepsake from their Prior-Life Tale.

atoms.exact_source_text: Colony contact is not required to validate its meaning.
atoms.normalized_claim: Colony contact is not required to validate a Keepsake's meaning.

atoms.exact_source_text: A new Keepsake may replace the current one only through a consequential meaning-making event with player confirmation.
atoms.normalized_claim: A new Keepsake may replace the current one only through a consequential meaning-making event with player confirmation.

atoms.exact_source_text: Accepting the new object retires the old
atoms.normalized_claim: Accepting the new Keepsake retires the old one.

atoms.exact_source_text: declining creates no reserve or backlog.
atoms.normalized_claim: Declining a new Keepsake creates no reserve or backlog.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Keepsake cannot be cleared or discarded through ordinary Citizen View or TRAVEL controls.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Keepsake cannot be cleared or discarded through ordinary Citizen View or TRAVEL controls.

atoms.exact_source_text: Separation occurs only through an explicit authored choice such as succession, gifting, sacrifice, or surrender.
atoms.normalized_claim: Separation from a Keepsake occurs only through an explicit authored choice such as succession, gifting, sacrifice, or surrender.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Hearth replacement may defer the former Keepsake to a Homecoming disposition: retire it or gift it to the Hearthmate.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Hearth replacement may defer the former Keepsake to a Homecoming disposition: retire it or gift it to the Hearthmate.

atoms.exact_source_text: A gift may replace the recipient's current Keepsake
atoms.normalized_claim: A gift may replace the recipient's current Keepsake.

atoms.exact_source_text: the recipient's former object retires without a transfer cascade.
atoms.normalized_claim: The recipient's former Keepsake object retires without a transfer cascade.

atoms.exact_source_text: Keepsakes are present, not used.
atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsakes are present, not used.

atoms.exact_source_text: They are never activated, spent, refreshed, charged, or placed on cooldown.
atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsakes are never activated, spent, refreshed, charged, or placed on cooldown.

atoms.exact_source_text: Their mechanical effects function only inside Encounter MEETs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsake mechanical effects function only inside Encounter MEETs.

atoms.exact_source_text: Focus Keepsake - associated with one Turn category.
atoms.normalized_claim: Focus Keepsake is associated with one Turn category.

atoms.exact_source_text: When the player independently chooses an Approach in that domain, the holder may take Focus and receive a narrow rider grounded in the same meaning.
atoms.normalized_claim: When the player independently chooses an Approach in the Focus Keepsake's domain, the holder may take Focus and receive a narrow rider grounded in the same meaning.

atoms.exact_source_text: Standing Keepsake - tied to one narrow Encounter condition.
atoms.normalized_claim: Standing Keepsake is tied to one narrow Encounter condition.

atoms.exact_source_text: It applies automatically to the holder when that condition occurs and does not require Focus.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Standing Keepsake applies automatically to the holder when its condition occurs and does not require Focus.

atoms.exact_source_text: Both modes use the shared operations Soften, Preserve, and Permit.
atoms.normalized_claim: Both Keepsake modes use the shared operations Soften, Preserve, and Permit.

atoms.exact_source_text: Effects remain holder-centered, bounded, and expressed through existing resolution systems.
atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsake effects remain holder-centered, bounded, and expressed through existing resolution systems.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Keepsake cannot create an Approach, reopen an unavailable Approach, or add a Turn category merely so that it can function.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Keepsake cannot create an Approach, reopen an unavailable Approach, or add a Turn category merely so that it can function.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Standing Keepsake may coexist with a Tool or Supply intervention
atoms.normalized_claim: A Standing Keepsake may coexist with a Tool or Supply intervention.

atoms.exact_source_text: multiple Standing effects do not stack onto one shared party consequence or stake.
atoms.normalized_claim: Multiple Standing Keepsake effects do not stack onto one shared party consequence or stake.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Focus Keepsake rider may recur whenever its conditions recur
atoms.normalized_claim: A Focus Keepsake rider may recur whenever its conditions recur.

atoms.exact_source_text: there is no frequency counter.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no frequency counter limiting a Focus Keepsake rider's recurrence.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Damaged Keepsake remains equipped and identity-visible while its effect is suspended.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Damaged Keepsake remains equipped and identity-visible while its effect is suspended.

atoms.exact_source_text: Damage clears automatically at the beginning of DWELL without cost, action, or de-equipping.
atoms.normalized_claim: Damage on a Keepsake clears automatically at the beginning of DWELL without cost, action, or de-equipping.
